item.description:
New • On Apple Silicon the CPU card shows the chip's power in watts. Hover it for CPU, GPU and Neural Engine, and agents reading Actvt over MCP get the same numbers in the snapshot and in history
Fixed • Claude Code background jobs and forked sessions no longer count the parent conversation's spend a second time • A Claude Code session resumed at the prompt, a terminal running a background copy, and a background handoff now show the right live state • Find (⌘F) in a session over 25 MB searches the whole session, not only the part on screen, and ⌘G opens each match

New • "Where it went" on the Overview now prices cache rebuilds, the turns where an agent paid to write its whole context again, and says whether the cache had expired or the context changed. Show me › opens the turns
Improved • Actvt does less work while its window is hidden and Remote Sessions are polling • Suggest tailnet hosts no longer starts the Tailscale app to read your tailnet, so it can't reconnect a VPN you switched off. Suggestions now need the standalone tailscale CLI
Fixed • Claude Code compactions are now counted: the inspector and context meter show "compacted N times", the transcript marks where each one happened, and agents reading a session over MCP get the real count • In a session over 25 MB, ⌘↑ and ⌘↓ go to the first and last turn instead of stopping partway

New • Presentable Mode hides dollar amounts, project names, branches and transcripts, so you can share your screen or record a demo without showing your work. Turn it on from the menu bar menu or Settings → Appearance • The share card has a new look and shows totals only
Improved • Agents can read long transcripts through Actvt's MCP tools a section at a time • Actvt uses less CPU while its window is hidden and an agent is writing • Remote hosts on an older actvt-cli are now told an update is available
Fixed • The Network card counts every active connection, so a laptop on Ethernet or a Mac mini on Wi-Fi shows its real traffic • MCP filters given whole numbers, such as a minimum cost of 100 or a date, now filter instead of being ignored • Claude Haiku 5.5 prompts over 100K tokens are priced at the long-prompt rate
